description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items.  This procurement will be a FAR requirement for Multiple Award BPAs for Instructor services under FAR 13.303.  $500,000 is the simplified acquisition threshold, unless agency regulations set a higher one.  BPA rules for On Ramping / reviewing annually will apply. The annual review allows for both on ramping and off ramping BPA applicants.
